title: Patch
description: A patch operation emitted by the Hypen engine during reconciliation

id.description: Unique identifier for the created element

absentProps.description: Fixture-assertion-only field (never on the wire): prop keys that must NOT be present on the matched patch's props. Pins omission contracts, e.g. an invalid .animate preset lowering to no __anim.animate prop and no raw animate.0 passthrough.

semantics.description: Accessibility semantics derived for this node (role, name, states, relationships). Omitted entirely when the node has no derivable semantics.
The complete re-resolved semantics block (not a field delta). Omitted when the node lost all derivable semantics — renderers must then clear everything.

valueIsNull.description: Fixture-assertion-only field (never on the wire): requires the matched patch's value to be EXPLICIT JSON null. Needed because `"value": null` in a fixture is indistinguishable from omitting the key (which matches ANY value) once deserialized — null contracts (e.g. __anim.states nulling its label on fallback) are otherwise unassertable.

beforeId.description: Move before this element (null = move to end)

transition.description: When true, the removed subtree has an exit animation (`__anim.exit` on this root): the renderer may defer teardown until the animation settles. Emitted FIRST, before any descendant removes. Omitted entirely when false — the wire format is unchanged for non-animated removals.

spec.description: Batch-scoped animation spec (Option D transaction-scoped animation). Always a complete object by the time it reaches the wire — the engine normalizes a bare curve string into {curve, duration: 250} and fills a missing duration with 250; unknown fields pass through (renderers own interpretation). This patch is the FIRST entry of a render batch triggered by a state update that carried an animation context: renderers that understand it animate every prop change in the batch (precedence: batch spec > node .transition > none); renderers that don't know the type ignore it and snap. A cycle producing no patches emits no prelude either — no stamp without patches.
